dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Can I have the menu, please?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. kən aɪ ˈhæv ðə ˈmɛnjuː, ˈpliːz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'd like chicken and rice, please.
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈlaɪk ˈtʃɪkən ənd ˈraɪs, ˈpliːz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: OK. And a glass of water?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ənd ə ˈɡlæs əv ˈwɔːtər?
